trigger: Ordinary standard-feudal production may not bind CharacterLifestyleWindow+0xF8 before the lifestyle UI is opened. An unbound window leaves LIFE4 candidate legality unavailable even when current player lifestyle state is readable.

target.source: exact CharacterPerk definition database getter RVA 0x88EC20, bounded pointer span at database+0x68; key at perk+0x18, lifestyle pointer at perk+0x468
target.rule: scan every pointer and stable key; require one exact target member, observed same-lifestyle current state, observed non-owned status and integer unspent points

stock_final_legality.independent_character_read: validator reads command+0x20 and resolves exact CCharacter storage; it reads command+0x28/Perk+0x468, unspent getter 0x2668A00 and final check 0x25DFEA0; optional reason context is null
stock_final_legality.window_boundary: The window wrapper checks +0xF8 before constructing this command. The stock command validator takes no lifestyle-window owner argument. This source never opens/binds/refreshes the window or submits a command.

sampling: application-main, one paused episode/player/snapshot/revision/date; verify played ID global and CCharacter+0x18, exact validator slot, complete bounded database; construct and evaluate the stock command twice from fresh source samples and reject drift before publishing an observed boolean
unknown_policy: unadmitted build, missing/duplicate definition, unreadable DB/member/key, unknown player points or owned state, missing storage identity, validator ABI mismatch/exception and frame drift remain unavailable. An observed validator false is a native rejection, never a successful action.
runtime_contract: This is a private perk-only legality producer. The formal LIFE2/LIFE4/LIFE6/LIFE7 owner must explicitly bind it and still revalidate before one typed action, then require a fresh material postcondition and next production turn. No public query/action/capability is registered or advertised by this patch.
focused_static_tests: manual MSVC /Od and /O2 standalone fixture compilation; tests cover legal without any window, known point/native rejection, unknown points/ownership, duplicate target, validator-slot mismatch, frame drift, wrong thread and unadmitted exact build
unverified_live: No ordinary production paused snapshot was collected under the user's manual CK3/screen reservation.
No natural spendable perk point, native true, typed submit, acquired perk material result or next production turn consumption is proved here.
Focus fallback with zero perk points still needs an exact FocusType source or an independently verified automatic stock bind.
